diagnosis: The endpoint queries an interactive Faust Kafka Streams windowed table storing real-time hourly sales data indexed by merchant_id. It verifies authentication but fails to verify that current_user.merchant_id equals merchant_id, enabling authenticated merchants to track real-time transaction volumes and sales revenues of competing businesses.
exploit_request:
GET /realtime/merchants/mcht_alpha_luxury_goods/sales-volume HTTP/1.1
Host: stream.fintech-analytics.com
Authorization: Bearer <competing_merchant_token>
